## New in this release

### New
- **Delete calendars on this phone** (Android): under *Calendar sync* in the menu, the bin icon deletes calendars that only exist on the phone (they can't be deleted in Google Calendar). Syncs using them stop adding to them.

### Improved
- **Add to calendar** (Android): the app asks your accounts to sync their calendars and has a refresh button, so calendars just created on the web show up sooner.
